## Download

| Platform | File |
| --- | --- |
| **Windows** (most PCs) | [Novex-Launcher_{version}_windows_x64-setup.exe]({download}/Novex-Launcher_{version}_windows_x64-setup.exe) |
| Windows on ARM | [Novex-Launcher_{version}_windows_arm64-setup.exe]({download}/Novex-Launcher_{version}_windows_arm64-setup.exe) |
| **macOS** (Apple silicon and Intel) | [Novex-Launcher_{version}_macos_universal.dmg]({download}/Novex-Launcher_{version}_macos_universal.dmg) |
| **Linux** (any distro) | [AppImage x64]({download}/Novex-Launcher_{version}_linux_amd64.AppImage) · [AppImage ARM64]({download}/Novex-Launcher_{version}_linux_aarch64.AppImage) |
| Debian / Ubuntu | [.deb x64]({download}/Novex-Launcher_{version}_linux_amd64.deb) · [.deb ARM64]({download}/Novex-Launcher_{version}_linux_arm64.deb) |
| Fedora / openSUSE | [.rpm x64]({download}/Novex-Launcher_{version}_linux_x86_64.rpm) · [.rpm ARM64]({download}/Novex-Launcher_{version}_linux_aarch64.rpm) |

On macOS, if the first launch is blocked, right-click the app and choose **Open**.
Already installed? Novex updates itself, so there's nothing to download.

<sub>The `.app.tar.gz` and `latest.json` files are used by the built-in updater.</sub>
